title: app_status structuredContent
description: The engine's version and schema (the number of its newest migration), and each model in the stack with its job and state (docs/models.md): the embeddings model (live, a shadow one when the settings name one, and the map's when graph.similarity.model names one) with its index, and the titles model with the kind of the failure that last stopped it. States and counts only. See contracts/README.md section 2.2.

role.description: shadow: an embeddings model whose index is built beside the live one's and read by no search. map: the model whose vectors make the map's similar and copy links (graph.similarity.model, listed only when set); it has no index.

name.description: The settings' name for the model; null for a titles model that is off.

id.description: The tag an embeddings model's vectors carry; null for the titles model.

state.description: off: the settings turn it off; starting: not loaded yet since the start; unverified: its files do not match their pinned checksums; failing: the titles model's newest rebuild stopped on a failure (kept across the engine's restarts).

index.description: An embeddings model's index; null for the titles model, before the counts were first read, and always while memory scopes are on (its counts are every scope's together).

indexing.description: Whether the index job covers this model (adapters.embeddings.backfill, sources or shadow).

pending.description: Rows still without this model's passages while the job covers it; null otherwise.
